sample_unit: evaluation pairs (original vs adversarial radiology report summaries)

links.outcome: Failure to reflect altered anatomical, certainty, and descriptor terms in summaries
links.effect: Even for the best summarizer, anatomical substitutions not reflected in 23.7% of summaries, diagnostic certainty in 22.3%, descriptor terms in 21.2%.
links.quote: Even for the highest-scoring summarizer, substitutions of anatomical terms were not reflected in 23.7% of summaries, diagnostic certainty in 22.3%, and descriptor terms (e.g., "substantial") in 21.2%.

unlisted_practices: LLM-as-a-judge automated evaluation validated against radiologist agreement
Adversarial dictionary-based term substitution framework for evaluating summarization

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and testing an adversarial robustness evaluation framework (stress testing / pre-deployment validation practice) for LLM-based patient-friendly radiology report summarization.
